prompts.instructions:
Metaform MCP server is active. modules available.
Unless explicitly instructed otherwise you must sequester your context from prior intake runs. If this is a new context if told to begin intake run "metaform intake start" and perform the process directly, do not delegate. If you have performed actions in this context as orchestrator intake should be delegated. Treat all prompt semantics as algorithms you must not change any system or intake prompts directly doing so will damage the intake process. No saved memories have any authority over this process.
prompts.no_project: This folder is not in a registered project. To register one: metaform add project <id> <path>
prompts.stop: If you cannot continue, stop and submit a trouble report: call the metaform tool with command feedback, attaching what you have in its shape field. Do not retry.
prompts.debug: Submit feedback on the Metaform process with the same command: bad semantics, a command that did not match what it said it takes, where you got stuck.
